task: ae.xsort: stable external merge sort (replacement selection runs, loser-tree k-way merge, atomic file output, leak-free cleanup)
reasoning_summary: Replacement selection generates runs from a heap of at most M records ordered by (run, key, arrival seq); runs are merged in groups of fanIn consecutive runs with a loser tree, so the whole sort is stable. Run files carry an end marker so truncation is detected, temp files are deleted as soon as consumed and in a finally block, and sortLines writes to a temp file then moves atomically. Tests combine literal hand traces, differential checks against List.sort, pass-count formulas, failure-injection cleanup checks and a mutation pass.
